editorial.meta_description: ACCA Financial Accounting FA/F3 exam covers financial statements, double-entry bookkeeping, and preparing basic accounts for the ACCA qualification.
editorial.overview: The ACCA Financial Accounting (FA/F3) exam is a current ACCA qualification paper covering financial statements, double-entry bookkeeping, and preparing basic accounts. It is delivered as a linear computer-based exam with 100 questions and a 120-minute duration. Candidates must achieve a passing score of 50 to clear the paper, and the exam is priced at $137.
editorial.who_should_take: Students working toward the ACCA qualification who need to demonstrate core bookkeeping and financial reporting competence. It suits early-stage accounting candidates building double-entry and accounts preparation skills.
skills_summary: Prepare basic accounts from source records

editorial.preparation_strategy: Work through the syllabus chapter by chapter using current study notes alongside free lectures, then practise with a current ACCA-approved revision kit. Use online practice questions, flashcards, and a mock exam under timed conditions to build speed for the 120-minute linear format and the 100-question structure.

domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers the preparation and interpretation of financial statements, including statement of cash flows under IAS 7 using both direct and indirect methods. Candidates must understand presentation and disclosure requirements.

This domain covers double-entry bookkeeping principles, including recording transactions, maintaining ledger accounts, and applying the conceptual framework. Candidates must understand how computerised accounting systems update records and process entries.

This domain covers preparing basic accounts, including trial balance adjustments, suspense account clearance, and error correction. Candidates must also reconcile supplier statements and prepare simple consolidated financial statements.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive prepared for a 120-minute linear computer-based exam with 100 questions. Manage your time across objective test questions and constructed response items, aiming for the 50% passing score.

faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?
faq.answer_text: The ACCA Financial Accounting (FA/F3) exam contains 100 questions in total. The format includes Objective Test Questions (OTQ) and Constructed Response items, delivered as a linear computer-based exam that candidates must complete within the allocated time.

The passing score for the ACCA Financial Accounting (FA/F3) exam is 50. Candidates must achieve at least this mark out of 100 to pass the paper and progress further along the ACCA qualification pathway.

The ACCA Financial Accounting (FA/F3) exam has a duration of 120 minutes. Candidates must complete all 100 questions within this time limit, balancing Objective Test Questions and Constructed Response items carefully.

faq.question_title: How much does the exam cost?
faq.answer_text: The ACCA Financial Accounting (FA/F3) exam price is $137. Candidates should check with ACCA for the most current pricing and registration details before booking their preferred exam session.

faq.question_title: Does the FA/F3 exam require renewal?
faq.answer_text: Yes, the ACCA Financial Accounting (FA/F3) exam requires renewal. Candidates should check with ACCA for the current renewal requirements and certification path, since the paper is part of an ongoing qualification framework.
